notes: Correctness fix, not a performance change. openai_shim.chat_completions called Tokenizer.encode_messages(messages) positionally and so inherited that method's thinking=True default, rendering <bos><|turn>system <|think|> <turn|> ahead of the user turn on every /v1/chat/completions request. No caller asked for that mode and no record chose it; the chat route now passes thinking=False explicitly. The assertion is the measurement: the regression test pins the rendered prompt, asserting no <|think|> block and a plain user turn. Verified failing at 1fc7855 in a detached worktree with this test file copied in (AssertionError: '<|think|>' is contained here: <bos><|turn>system / <|think|> / <turn|> / <|turn>user) and passing at 9bf2bd3. research/chat_template.py's SHIM_ENABLE_THINKING follows the call site because its whole job is recording what the shim passes; that is a research-package file and exempt from this gate. Behaviour does change, which is why this is not a no-claim record: the model now answers without a thinking preamble, and the measured effect on the corpus is in kb-20260919-5db5aafa.
